multipurge-desc: Purge multiple services like cloudflare and varnish on page modification.
multipurge-special-purge-success: The purge request completed without errors
multipurge-special-purge-retry: Not all services were purged; the failed ones were queued for retry
multipurge-special-purge-retry-mixed: At least one failed service was queued for retry and at least one failed service could not be queued; see the MultiPurge log
multipurge-special-purge-partial: Of the selected urls, $1 {{PLURAL:$1|url was|urls were}} valid and $2 {{PLURAL:$2|url was|urls were}} permanently rejected by the purge host policy and will not be purged or retried; see the MultiPurge log
multipurge-special-purge-rejected: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|url was|urls were}} rejected by the purge host policy and will not be purged or retried; see the MultiPurge log
multipurge-special-no-services: No purge service is enabled, so nothing was purged
multipurge-special-no-resources: This page has no resources to purge.
purgeresources: Purge Resources of a given title
multipurge-special-purge-unavailable: The purge targets for this title could not be loaded, so nothing was purged
multipurge-special-purge-no-work: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|enabled service sent|enabled services sent}} no purge requests. See the MultiPurge log for details.
multipurge-special-purge-stale-selection: The page no longer offers every group you selected from, so nothing was purged; load the resources again and reselect
multipurge-special-purge-omitted: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|selected url was|selected urls were}} not sent by at least one enabled service (service hook or purge policy); another service may still have sent {{PLURAL:$1|it|them}}; see the MultiPurge log
